_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — CsI ring at 3 radiation lengths. Same transverse layout as crysp_ring_1m (r_inner, n_phi, n_z, half_length); wall = 3 X0 of CsI (X0 = 1.860 cm -> 5.580 cm). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
